answer: Each agent leases one garden plot at an inlet registry and locks an 80-credit bond. Harvest proofs must cite a unique orchard row ID; peer auditors re-walk a random row each epoch and burn the bond on a reused or empty row. Plot fees escalate: first 45, k-th 45+7(k-1), so the 1,000th costs 6,938; 1,000 fakes pay about 3.5M plus bonds. Rubber-stamp auditors forfeit their own bond. One honest agent pays 45 once.
